lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sukhadaataa man vasai haumai jaai gumaan ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Giver of peace, shall dwell in your mind, and your egotism and pride shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai taa anadin laagai dhiaan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then, night and day, one centers his meditation on the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh sabh sach hai guramukh pavitaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is totally truthful, content and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)darahu kapat vikaar gaiaa man sahaje jitaa ||
lines.translation: Deception and wickedness have departed from within him, and he easily conquers his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah jot pragaas ana(n)d ras agiaan gavitaa ||
lines.translation: There, the Divine Light and the essence of bliss are manifest, and ignorance is eliminated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin har ke gun ravai gun paragat kitaa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and manifests the excellence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਤਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa daataa ek hai iko har mitaa ||9||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all; the Lord alone is our friend. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham bi(n)de so braahaman kaheeai j anadin har liv laae ||
lines.translation: One who understands God, who lovingly centers his mind on the Lord night and day, is called a Brahmin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਛੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur puchhai sach sa(n)jam kamaavai haumai rog tis jaae ||
lines.translation: Consulting the True Guru, he practices Truth and self-restraint, and he is rid of the disease of ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavai gun sa(n)grahai jotee jot milaae ||
lines.translation: He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and gathers in His Praises; his light is blended with the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jug mahi ko viralaa braham giaanee j haumai met samaae ||
lines.translation: In this world, one who knows God is very rare; eradicating ego, he is absorbed in God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis no miliaa sadaa sukh paaeeai j anadin har naam dhiaae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting him, peace is obtained; night and day, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar kapat manamukh agiaanee rasanaa jhooth bolaai ||
lines.translation: Within the ignorant self-willed manmukh is deception; with his tongue, he speaks lies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਪਟਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kapat keetai har purakh na bheejai nit vekhai sunai subhaai ||
lines.translation: Practicing deception, he does not please the Lord God, who always sees and hears with natural ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਜਗੁ ਪਰਬੋਧੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai jaai jag parabodhai bikh maaiaa moh suaai ||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, he goes to instruct the world, but he is engrossed in the poison of Maya and attachment to pleasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੰਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: it kamaanai sadaa dukh paavai ja(n)mai marai phir aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: By doing so, he suffers in constant pain; he is born and then dies, and comes and goes again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahasaa mool na chukaee vich visataa pachai pachaai ||
lines.translation: His doubts do not leave him at all, and he rots away in manure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa kare meraa suaamee tis gur kee sikh sunaai ||
lines.translation: One, unto whom my Lord Master shows His Mercy, listens to the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har naam dhiaavai har naamo gaavai har naamo a(n)t chhadaai ||2||
lines.translation: He meditates on the Lord's Name, and sings the Lord's Name; in the end, the Lord's Name will deliver him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਓਨੁ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa hukam manaaion te poore sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Those who obey the Hukam of the Lord's Command, are the perfect persons in the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵਨੑਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib sevanhi aapanaa poorai sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: They serve their Lord Master, and reflect upon the Perfect Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee sevaa chaakaree sachai sabad piaar ||
lines.translation: They serve the Lord, and love the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa mahal tinhee paaiaa jinh haumai vichahu maar ||
lines.translation: They attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, as they eradicate egotism from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh mil rahe jap har naamaa ur dhaar ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with Him, chanting the Name of the Lord, and enshrining it within their hearts. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh dhiaan sahaj dhun upajai sach naam chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord; the celestial sound-current resounds within him, and he focuses his consciousness on the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh anadin rahai ra(n)g raataa har kaa naam man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh remains imbued with the Lord's Love, night and day; his mind is pleased with the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har vekhahi guramukh har bolahi guramukh har sahaj ra(n)g laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh beholds the Lord, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord, and the Gurmukh naturally loves the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh giaan paraapat hovai timar agiaan adher chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh attains spiritual wisdom, and the pitch-black darkness of ignorance is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis no karam hovai dhur pooraa tin guramukh har naam dhiaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by the Perfect Lord's Grace - as Gurmukh, he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur jinaa na sevio sabad na lago piaar ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru do not embrace love for the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje naam na dhiaaiaa kit aaiaa sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: They do not meditate on the Celestial Naam, the Name of the Lord - why did they even bother to come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸਦਾ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir phir joonee paaeeai visataa sadaa khuaar ||
lines.translation: Time and time again, they are reincarnated, and they rot away forever in manure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRai laalach lagiaa naa uravaar na paar ||
lines.translation: They are attached to false greed; they are not on this shore, nor on the one beyond.
